caption: Borg Nienoord, Leek
composition: Neoclassical villa of 1886 behind the 1708 gate · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Borg Nienoord is the neoclassical villa rebuilt in 1885-1886 after the fire, smaller than the old borg, seen with the sculpted gate of 1708. It is not a medieval tower house. The upper floor lost in 1846 was not restored as a keep. It is overcast, about 10.9°C, with wind near 4.7 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The museum is closed. No name is readable. Late September, no flower display.
